(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_cases hA : A ∈ P
    · exact Or.inl hA
    · right
      by_contra hAc
      have hex : ∃ U ∈ P, A ∩ U = ∅ := by
        by_contra hn
        apply hPS ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
        intro U hU
        by_contra hd
        exact hn ⟨U, hU, hd⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hex
      have hsub : U ⊆ Aᶜ := by
        intro x hx hxA
        have hmem : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hx⟩
        exact False.elim (by simpa [hAU] using hmem)
      apply hPS ⟨Aᶜ, hAc, ?_⟩
      intro V hV hdis
      apply hPP U hU V hV
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      intro hx
      have hmem : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨hsub hx.1, hx.2⟩
      exact False.elim (by simpa [hdis] using hmem)
  have hnot : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have h : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    apply h
    ext x
    simp
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  have hPQ : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by
    intro A hA
    simp [Q, hnot A hA]
  have hQP : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A hA
    have hA' : A ∉ P := by simpa [Q] using hA
    exact (hc A).resolve_left hA'
  have hcard : P.card = Q.card := by
    refine Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact hPQ
    · exact hQP
    · intro A hA
      simp
    · intro A hA
      simp
  have hsum : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    simpa [Q, Nat.add_comm] using
      (Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (Finset.subset_univ P))
  have hn : 0 < Fintype.card S := Fintype.card_pos
  have hp : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hn]
